findings.title: Punctuation at the wrong end
findings.message: "فهمت. سأ reported these to the technical…" runs right to left, so its last mark moves to the start.
findings.fix: Give the block the direction of its own text, with dir="ltr", dir="rtl" or dir="auto".
findings.snippet: فهمت. سأ reported these to the technical team. Please wait.

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: border-bottom-right-radius: 4px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.
